<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919961_theRebbe_975" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919961_theRebbe_975__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Dovid's response to Hashem teaches that the essential point beyond general and particular is learned from Hashem, and this point connects to details in two ways: from details upward to the point, and from the point downward to details.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing what is brought in Midrash Tehillim on the verse,</t>
    <t s="2">"One thing I asked of Hashem..."</t>
    <t s="3">The Holy One, blessed be He, said to Dovid,</t>
    <t s="4">"At first you say, 'One thing I asked'</t>
    <t s="5">(...)</t>
    <t s="6">'that I dwell in the House of Hashem,' and afterwards you ask several things: 'to behold the pleasantness of Hashem' and 'to visit His Sanctuary,' etc."</t>
    <t s="7">And Dovid answered, "From You I learned:</t>
    <t s="8">At first You did not come upon me</t>
    <t s="9">except with one thing, as it is said, 'And now, Israel, what does Hashem your G-d ask of you but to fear,' and afterwards You opened upon us many commandments, as it is said, 'to walk in all His ways and to cleave to Him,' etc."</t>
    <t s="10">And it needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="11">for seemingly Dovid's answer "From You I learned" does not resolve the statement "One thing I asked,"</t>
    <t s="12">but rather it says that the question is about the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="13">that at first He says "but to fear" and afterwards He opened with many commandments.</t>
    <t s="14">And the Maggid explained,</t>
    <t s="15">that Dovid requested only one thing alone,</t>
    <t s="16">for the detailed matters</t>
    <t s="17">("to behold the pleasantness of Hashem" etc.)</t>
    <t s="18">are branches of "that I dwell in the House of Hashem."</t>
    <t s="19">And similarly regarding "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you but to fear,"</t>
    <t s="20">the detailed matters</t>
    <t s="21">("to walk in all His ways" etc.)</t>
    <t s="22">are branches of "to fear Hashem your G-d."</t>
    <t s="23">But,</t>
    <t s="24">according to this, it needs to be understood from the other side,</t>
    <t s="25">behold this matter</t>
    <t s="26">(that there are general matters from which many details branch)</t>
    <t s="27">is understood simply,</t>
    <t s="28">and why is it necessary to learn this from the Holy One, blessed be He?</t>
    <t s="29">And the point of the explanation in this is,</t>
    <t s="30">that the intention here in "one thing alone" is the essential point that is above general and details.</t>
    <t s="31">For this is what Dovid said, "One thing I asked,"</t>
    <t s="32">"One" is Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="33">the intrinsically singular,</t>
    <t s="34">that is not in the category of division into details</t>
    <t s="35">(as is known the distinction between Yachid and Echad).</t>
    <t s="36">And similarly regarding "to fear Hashem,"</t>
    <t s="37">for the explanation of "to fear Hashem"</t>
    <t s="38">(for the word "et" indicates something that is only secondary)</t>
    <t s="39">is that he has no existence of his own at all,</t>
    <t s="40">and his entire matter is only that he is secondary and nullified to Hashem.</t>
    <t s="41">And also according to what is explained in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="42">that "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you but to fear Hashem your G-d" refers to lower fear,</t>
    <t s="43">behold it is known,</t>
    <t s="44">that all the levels of fear are related to each other.</t>
    <t s="45">And also the self-nullification of lower fear is from the essence of the soul.</t>
    <t s="46">And as is known the distinction between fear and love,</t>
    <t s="47">that love, because it is a state of existence, is from the revelations of the soul,</t>
    <t s="48">and fear, because it is self-nullification, is from the essence of the soul.</t>
    <t s="49">And this is "From You I learned,"</t>
    <t s="50">for in order to connect the details with the essential point that is above general and details,</t>
    <t s="51">there is need for learning and empowerment from the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="52">And the connection of the essential point with the details is in two ways.</t>
    <t s="53">First,</t>
    <t s="54">in a manner from below to above,</t>
    <t s="55">that through the details one reaches the point.</t>
    <t s="56">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="57">"And Hashem commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Hashem,"</t>
    <t s="58">that through the fulfillment of the commandments</t>
    <t s="59">(the 613 particular commandments)</t>
    <t s="60">one comes to fear Hashem.</t>
    <t s="61">And second,</t>
    <t s="62">in a manner from above to below,</t>
    <t s="63">that from the point details are drawn and branch forth,</t>
    <t s="64">and in a manner that even after the details have been drawn,</t>
    <t s="65">the essential point that is above the source of the details shines within them.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The word "Mah" signifies essential self-nullification from the soul's essence, from which all details branch, and this nullification is higher than the nullification of fear which is still within the category of soul revelations.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, we can explain what they said, "Do not read 'Mah' but rather 'Me'ah,'</t>
    <t s="2">"Mah" is self-nullification, like "and we are what (mah)"</t>
    <t s="3">[And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="4">that this is that the term "Mah" indicates the smallness of the thing</t>
    <t s="5">(as above in section 2),</t>
    <t s="6">which is similar to what is said, "You are the smallest of all the nations," that they make themselves small],</t>
    <t s="7">and it is the essential self-nullification that is from the essence of the soul.</t>
    <t s="8">And the explanation of "What (Mah) does Hashem your G-d ask of you" is that Hashem your G-d asks of you the self-nullification of Mah.</t>
    <t s="9">And from this self-nullification all the details enumerated later in the verse branch forth,</t>
    <t s="10">including also "to fear Hashem."</t>
    <t s="11">For despite the fact that also the self-nullification of fear is from the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="12">and this self-nullification is the essential point from which the subsequent details branch</t>
    <t s="13">("to walk in all His ways" etc.),</t>
    <t s="14">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="15">since the self-nullification is in the form of fear,</t>
    <t s="16">whose matter is</t>
    <t s="17">(like all the emotions)</t>
    <t s="18">the feeling that he is afraid,</t>
    <t s="19">it is included in the revelations of the soul,</t>
    <t s="20">but the self-nullification of Mah is essential self-nullification.</t>
    <t s="21">Like the self-nullification of mesirus nefesh</t>
    <t s="22">that is in every Jew,</t>
    <t s="23">from the Mah within him,</t>
    <t s="24">which is above all the faculties including even the faculty of will,</t>
    <t s="25">for that he gives his life is not from his will but because he cannot be separated, G-d forbid, from His Oneness.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is "What (Mah) Hashem your G-d,"</t>
    <t s="27">that the self-nullification of Mah is because Hashem</t>
    <t s="28">(He)</t>
    <t s="29">is your G-d, your strength and vitality.</t>
    <t s="30">For since Divinity is his vitality,</t>
    <t s="31">it is not applicable at all that he should be separated, G-d forbid, from Divinity.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The self-nullification of Mah is inherently concealed, and it is revealed through the service of the details (Me'ah), so that the revelation of Mah also permeates the particular faculties.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">But,</t>
    <t s="2">the self-nullification of Mah that exists in every Jew is in concealment.</t>
    <t s="3">And this concealment is not only because of the animal soul that conceals and hides it,</t>
    <t s="4">but also from its own side it is hidden,</t>
    <t s="5">because it is above revelation.</t>
    <t s="6">And in order for it to be revealed,</t>
    <t s="7">about this they said, "Do not read 'Mah' but rather 'Me'ah.'</t>
    <t s="8">For Mah and Me'ah are two extremes.</t>
    <t s="9">Mah is an essential point that is above the category of details,</t>
    <t s="10">and Me'ah is a multitude of details up to the greatest multiplicity.</t>
    <t s="11">And in the soul of man, it is the ten faculties, each of which is comprised of ten.</t>
    <t s="12">And through the service in the particular faculties</t>
    <t s="13">(Me'ah),</t>
    <t s="14">the point of Mah is aroused and revealed.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is "Do not read 'Mah' but rather 'Me'ah,'</t>
    <t s="16">for Mah from its own side is above revelation – "Do not read"</t>
    <t s="17">(reading is revelation),</t>
    <t s="18">and its revelation is through the service of Me'ah.</t>
    <t s="19">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="20">the revelation of Mah</t>
    <t s="21">(that is brought about through the service of Me'ah)</t>
    <t s="22">is in a general manner and is also felt in the particular faculties.</t>
    <t s="23">And it can be said that this too is hinted at in "Do not read 'Mah' but rather 'Me'ah,'</t>
    <t s="24">for when the revelation of Mah is only in a general way,</t>
    <t s="25">then,</t>
    <t s="26">the revelation is only regarding the Mah</t>
    <t s="27">(that was initially in concealment and afterwards was revealed from its concealment),</t>
    <t s="28">and this is "Do not read 'Mah' but rather 'Me'ah,'</t>
    <t s="29">that the reading and revelation of Mah needs to be not only regarding the Mah but also in the particular faculties,</t>
    <t s="30">Me'ah.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
